page.overview:
Who is Cherry Chris?

Cherry Chris is one of the Ghost Destroyers hired by Ant-Ghost Princess

First arrived to help Princess Bubblegum remove the ghost from her room.

She has a Cherry as a head and looks as if she is wearing a diving suit. Category:Female Category:Comic Book Characters
